Alembic migration script to add and index a computed "depth" column in the "v2_node" table.

# Purpose
This code is a database migration script using Alembic, a database migration tool for SQLAlchemy. It defines an [`upgrade`](<#upgrade>) function that adds a new column named `depth` to the `v2_node` table. The `depth` column is an integer that is computed based on the length of the `relative_path` column, specifically calculating the depth of a node by counting the slashes in the path. An index is also created on the `depth` column to optimize queries. The [`downgrade`](<#downgrade>) function reverses these changes by removing the index and the `depth` column from the `v2_node` table.
